title: Full-disk overwrite destroys the previous document
steps: S02: retrieve LONG.WP5; F10, ORIGINAL.WP5, Enter, Y. Repeat on fresh full-input.img in S04 via F7, Y, ORIGINAL.WP5, Enter, Y.
observed: Both attempts report Disk Full. ORIGINAL.WP5 changes from 373 bytes to ZERO bytes. The new 8,727-byte document remains in memory, but the previously saved version is gone. Serial: create succeeds, write(n=8727) returns 0, close returns 0.
expected: A failed save must preserve the last saved version (data-integrity expectation, not a claimed historical WP atomic-save measurement).
guess: os/iword/app/face_a.c:1247-1258 creates/truncates the destination before the failing write; no rollback is visible (guess).

title: Failed new saves leave zero-byte document files
steps: S02, after L001: F1 twice; F10 NEW.WP5 Enter. Later fill the released cluster by changing Setup, then F10 SMALL.WP5 Enter.
observed: Both saves fail and leave named zero-byte files. NEW.WP5 and SMALL.WP5 are not usable WP documents.
expected: A failed new save should remove its incomplete destination or clearly identify it as incomplete (auditor expectation).

title: Resizing hides the status line and every prompt

expected: An enabled grow control must preserve access to document status and prompts; classic Mac window behavior from memory.
guess: os/iword/app/face_a.c:843 uses fixed editing geometry and the event handler at 2412 has no resize adaptation (guess).

title: Directories silently lose all entries after file 254
steps: S03 input contains MANY/F000.WP5 through F269.WP5. F5 Enter, Down Right Right Right Enter Enter. Down 140 times, Right, Down. F1; Shift-F10 MANY\F269.WP5 Enter.
observed: List Files reports 254 files and 86,868 used bytes; the list ends at F253. F269 retrieves successfully by name. Sixteen existing documents are omitted without a warning.
expected: Project contract pubs/manuals/initechword-reference/ref-l.tex:73: "List Files shows the documents and other files on the data diskette". The fixture actually contains 270 files, 92,340 bytes.
guess: os/iword/app/face_a.c:1369 LF_MAX=256 and :1412 bounded find; dot entries consume two slots (guess).

expected: Finder should bring the document forward for its save decision, or visibly explain the refusal (classic Mac shutdown expectation from memory). This is a blocked shutdown, not demonstrated data loss.

Refusing an ordinary multi-page document is an interoperability gap. The project documents refusal of unknown codes in ref-w.tex:48.
